<h2>Teaching resources</h2>
<p>Selected resources from behavioural economics teaching use explicit learning objectives, a benchmark-versus-behaviour structure, worked numerical examples, and assessment-relevant synthesis.</p>
<p class="inline-links"><a href="/teaching/behavioural-economics/">Behavioural economics resources</a><a href="/blog/">Related writing</a></p>

<h2>Research supervision</h2>
<p>I supervise doctoral and MSc research as principal and co-supervisor, especially where projects involve health economics, discrete choice experiments, behavioural methods, eye tracking, clinical outcomes assessment, or health policy.</p>
